quotes.text: D211271 questioned fromAddr and msgDate because their values were falsy. The author kept `const options = { fromAddr: "", msgDate: null };` because getVerifyDetails receives them. This exact object landed and remains in decryption.sys.mjs. For this attachment path, preserve or deliberately update those named inputs when changing the RNP call. This is a scoped review choice, not a rule to add empty options everywhere.
